scope: Fixed original execution paths with realized costs restored. Not zero-cost reoptimized trading, not zero-cost PPO training, not an upper bound over all policies.
metric: Mean paired one-decision-interval value in bp, reset to benchmark state; NOT cumulative or continuous portfolio return. Medians are across three already-viewed folds.
fixed_control: Action chosen by the 2-lot fitting-label mean of each target, NOT the best continuous fixed strategy. Restored-target control is long duration in all three folds, reused at 1 lot.
